notes: This contract pins Umbra's IEEE 1516.1-2025 reference-time implementation to source-derived Requirements-Lab records. It checks implementation symbols and Catch2 selectors only. The default packaged profile keeps getTimeFactory, federation creation, and time-management services unavailable; the non-installable development profile separately traces its getTimeFactory adapter through an exact Lab API-surface contract. Neither contract is a public-service catalog entry, JUnit evidence record, or conformance claim.
